[ASSISTANT_SAID] Shinjuku is described as a food lover's paradise with diverse options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Japanese food spots:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Tsukemen Gyoza Ichi (Shinjuku Gyoenmae): Popular for tsukemen and gyozas.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Toriyoshi (Shinjuku 3-chome): Modern yakitori restaurant with a variety of skewers.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. La Rotisserie (Shinjuku Gyoenmae): French-inspired rotisserie chicken joint.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. El Pescador (Shinjuku 2-chome): Modern Mexican restaurant with seafood dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended cafes and desserts:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Koffee Mameya (Shinjuku Gyoenmae): Specialty coffee shop.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Patisserie Kihachi (Shinjuku 3-chome): French-Japanese patisserie.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Harajuku Cream Puff Cafe (Shinjuku Station): Cafe serving cream puffs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended food courts and markets:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Shinjuku Odakyu Shinjuku Mylord Food Hall (Shinjuku Station): Variety of restaurants.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Shinjuku Central Market (Shinjuku 1-chome): Market with fresh produce and prepared foods.
